international.title: Jess Wilson’s rapid rise is hard to believe - but Victorian Labor’s collapse has been years in the making
international.summary: Labor faces possibility of relegation to crossbench as Coalition claims majority government and Greens celebrate ‘wild’ success Full report: Victorian Coalition wins majority government as Labor suffers historic defeat ‘Worse than anyone feared’: how Victorian Labor unravelled after 12 years in government Victoria election live results: votes tracker, map and seat counts It is difficult to overstate how far the Victorian Coalition has come. In the days after Christmas 2024, Brad Battin toppled John Pesutto as Liberal leader after a court found the Hawthorn MP defamed his colleague. A million-dollar loan by the party to Pesutto to help cover his legal costs also ended up in court. Battin lasted less than a year before his leadership also came undone and he was replaced by Jess Wilson in November 2025. Continue reading...
